semantics.base: primary_sample=True is always enforced; its minimum rating count is 100.
semantics.filters: Omit a field for All. Values within one field are OR; different fields are AND. An explicit empty list is an empty set.
semantics.null: JSON null in page_band/publication_decade/publisher_clean selects the missing bucket.
semantics.genres: Exact raw labels, case-sensitive; UNION of matching Book Id values, never repeated book rows.
semantics.publisher_clean: Exact case-sensitive normalized labels, translated to surrogate keys by the model test.
semantics.book_ids: Exact set of search-result IDs, not substring matching of title text.
semantics.sd: Sample standard deviation, ddof=1; null for fewer than 2 records.
semantics.empty: n=0; mean/median/sd=null; missing counts=0; top list empty.
semantics.genre_union_n: Distinct selected Book Ids with a bridge membership in the selected genre set, or any genre when no genre filter exists. Default is 8400, not8402.
semantics.genre_memberships_n: Number of bridge rows for selected books and selected genres; can exceed the distinct book count.
semantics.topn: Exact min(N,candidate count), ordered by rating DESC, n_ratings DESC, numeric book_id ASC.
